### Intervention

An intervention is something a person did that changed how a task turned out, which the pilot wants to bring to zero. Each kind says why it counts. Approving or rejecting a proposal is how the planner is meant to be used, and a plain retry (no note) only asks again, so neither is here.

| Field  | Type                                                  | Comment |
| ------ | ----------------------------------------------------- | ------- |
| `kind` | `string`                                              |         |
| `why`  | `string`                                              |         |
| `is`   | `(e: ScorecardEvent, task: ScorecardTask) => boolean` |         |

### InterventionCount

| Field     | Type                     | Comment                               |
| --------- | ------------------------ | ------------------------------------- |
| `total`   | `number`                 |                                       |
| `tasks`   | `number`                 | Distinct tasks that had at least one. |
| `by_kind` | `Record<string, number>` |                                       |

## `domain/landing/`

### AutoMergeCheck

Whether a merge goes ahead, waits or needs a person, and why: auto-merge's check, or a merge request's.

| Field       | Type                           | Comment                                                                                                  |
| ----------- | ------------------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `verdict`   | `"merge" \| "wait" \| "never"` | `merge`: go ahead. `wait`: something that can still change on its own. `never`: it needs a person.       |
| `reasons`   | `MergeReason[]`                | Why it waits or needs a person; empty for `merge`.                                                       |
| `conflict?` | `true \| undefined`            | Set when one of the reasons is the merge finding of kind `conflict`: the branch conflicts with the base. |

### AutoMergeFacts

What only auto-merge's check reads, beside the merge input: the repo's limits, a pause, and the branch as measured.

| Field       | Type                                                                                                 | Comment                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| ----------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `repo`      | `Pick<Repo, "test_cmd" \| "auto_merge_max_lines" \| "auto_merge_skip"> & Partial<CodeCommentLimits>` |                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `paused`    | `string \| null`                                                                                     | Why the daemon or the repo is paused; null when neither is.                                                                                                                                  |
| `measured?` | `AutoMergeMeasured \| null \| undefined`                                                             | The branch measured locally (`git diff --numstat` against the base); null or missing when it couldn't be.                                                                                    |
| `review?`   | `ReviewFacts \| null \| undefined`                                                                   | What the review gate reads (`reviewGate`), in a repo with auto_review on; null or missing when it is off. Only auto-merge waits on review runs: a person's merge and a merge request do not. |

### AutoMergeMeasured

A branch measured locally against the limits: the lines it changed against the base and the paths it touches.

| Field            | Type                                    | Comment                                                                             |
| ---------------- | --------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `lines`          | `number`                                |                                                                                     |
| `paths`          | `string[]`                              |                                                                                     |
| `code_comments?` | `CodeCommentCount \| null \| undefined` | The code comment lines the branch adds; null or missing when they couldn't be read. |

### AutoMergeSetting

What a task says about its own auto-merge: its setting (null follows the repo) and who made it.

| Field        | Type              | Comment |

| `auto_merge` | `boolean \| null` |         |
| `source`     | `string`          |         |

| Field           | Type                                                                            | Comment                                                                                                                        |
| --------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `state`         | `AutoMergeState`                                                                |                                                                                                                                |

One fact about a PR that bears on merging it. A problem stops any merge; anything else is a warning a person may wave through.

| --------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------- |

| `problem` | `boolean`                                                                                                                                                 |         |
| `text`    | `string`                                                                                                                                                  |         |
